Targets.title: Daily targets

lead.CALORIES: Energy, macros and fluid for each day type. The client tracks calories.
lead.PORTIONS: Hand portions and fluid for each day type. The client counts portions.
lead.GUIDANCE: The client tracks without numbers, so only fluid is set here.

Targets.empty: Fill in at least one target.
Targets.restText: Also used on training and competition days left empty.
Targets.fallbackText: Left empty, the rest day's targets apply.
Targets.mismatch: more than 5 % off the energy entered
Targets.suggestMissing: To suggest targets, the profile needs sex, birth date, height and weight.
Targets.suggestMissingWeight: To suggest fluid, the profile needs a weight.
Targets.copy: Copy the rest day to the others

Plan.title: Plan
Plan.lead: Meals for each day type, your recommendations and what is specific to this client.
Plan.noMeals: No meals for this day type. Without them the client's day uses Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner and Snacks.
Plan.specificsText: Anything about this client the plan should follow, shown with the plan.

copy.title: Copy a plan to {name}
copy.text: The chosen client's current targets apply from today, and their meals and recommendations replace these. The specifics stay. Older targets remain in the history.

lead.CALORIES: Daily energy and macro targets, your meals and your coach's recommendations.
lead.PORTIONS: Count portions by hand: a palm of protein, a cupped hand of carbs, a fist of veg, a thumb of fat.
lead.GUIDANCE: No counting: follow the meals and recommendations below.

ClientPlan.noTargets: Your coach hasn't set targets yet.

palms.title: A palm of protein
palms.text: Meat, fish, eggs, tofu or quark as big and thick as your palm without the fingers.

hands.title: A cupped hand of carbs
hands.text: Rice, pasta, potatoes, oats or fruit, as much as fits in your cupped hand.

fists.title: A fist of vegetables
fists.text: Vegetables or salad the size of your closed fist.

thumbs.title: A thumb of fats
thumbs.text: Oil, butter, nuts, seeds or cheese the size of your whole thumb.

welcome.text: What clients read on the first screen after accepting your invite, signed with your name.

Profile.title: Profile
Profile.lead: Your coach builds your plan from this. Update it whenever something changes.
Profile.coachLead: Client profile. The client sees and edits it too.

personal.title: Personal information
personal.text: Height, weight, age and sex give the suggested daily energy intake.

goals.title: Goals
goals.text: The main goal, an optional target weight and date, and what success looks like.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.text: The plan is built around the foods liked and the number of meals a day.

dietary.title: Dietary information
dietary.text: Diet type and allergies flag the recipes that don’t fit.

training.title: Training and sport
training.text: Entering a sport turns on the Training section.

additional.title: Additional information
additional.text: Health conditions, medications and anything else the coach should know.

welcome.title: {coach} welcomes you
welcome.lead: Three short steps before you start. Your answers are saved as you go.
welcome.defaultText: Welcome! Before I put your plan together, I need to get to know you: how you eat, how you train and what you want to achieve. It takes about ten minutes, and you can change everything later in your profile.

next.about: Personal details, diet and allergies, training, preferences and how you would like to track your food.
next.goal: What you want to achieve, and by when if you know.
next.done: {coach} gets your answers and builds your plan from them.

about.title: About you
about.lead: Fill in what you know. Only your name is required; you can add the rest later in your profile.

tracking.title: How you would like to track food
tracking.text: Pick what would suit you. Your coach makes the final call.
tracking.set: Your coach has already chosen “{mode}”. Your preference still goes to them.

modes.CALORIES: Log what you eat and see calories, protein, carbs and fat against your targets. The most precise, and the most time.
modes.PORTIONS: Count portions with your hand: a palm of protein, a cupped hand of carbs, a fist of vegetables, a thumb of fats. No weighing.
modes.GUIDANCE: No numbers: for each meal in your plan you just mark whether you followed it.

goal.title: Your goal
goal.lead: Your main goal shapes how the plan is built.
goal.targetText: Optional, if you have a number or a date in mind.

done.title: All set
done.lead: {coach} gets a notification and builds your plan from your answers. You can change them any time in your profile.
